text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"The Hopeful Stakes.
It is one of the stages that determines
the Junior Class champion."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —And after this G1, I shall ascend to even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You understand what that means, don't you,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: This is just one stepping stone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's right. Which is exactly why the King will deliver the most magnificent, beautiful, and supreme run.
